failedIssues.title: ASP.NET Web Forms incompatible with .NET 8
failedIssues.failureReason: This is a legacy ASP.NET Web Forms application (System.Web.UI) that cannot be directly migrated to .NET 8 without significant application architecture changes
failedIssues.errorDetails: 114 compilation errors - System.Web.UI namespace does not exist in .NET 8. ASP.NET Web Forms is not supported in .NET Core/.NET 5+
failedIssues.suggestedApproach: This requires a full application migration strategy: 1) Keep on .NET Framework 4.7.2 with modern tooling, OR 2) Rewrite to ASP.NET Core Razor Pages/MVC/Blazor, OR 3) Use incremental migration with SystemWebAdapters (requires significant code refactoring)

fixesApplied: Added SystemWebAdapters packages (insufficient for Web Forms)

issuesRemaining.issue: System.Web.UI namespace not available in .NET Core/.NET 5+
issuesRemaining.reason: ASP.NET Web Forms is a .NET Framework-only technology that requires complete application rewrite for .NET Core/.NET 8

recommendations: CRITICAL: This is an ASP.NET Web Forms application that cannot compile on .NET 8 without complete application migration
Option 1: Keep application on .NET Framework 4.7.2 or upgrade to 4.8 (no code changes needed)
Option 2: Full rewrite to ASP.NET Core (Razor Pages, MVC, or Blazor) - requires significant development effort
Option 3: Incremental migration using SystemWebAdapters + extensive refactoring of all Web Forms pages
This is NOT a build configuration issue - it requires business logic/application architecture changes
Project file has been modified to SDK-style .NET 8 format but code is incompatible
